highlights.title: Claude Code v2.1.237 Released
highlights.summary: This release introduces a new built-in 'Concise' output style that makes Claude lead with results and skip preamble, while still doing thorough work under the hood. You can enable it via /config under 'Output style'. It also fixes prompt caching for users on LLM gateways or custom base URLs.

highlights.title: Claude Code v2.1.236 Released
highlights.summary: Adds the ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL environment variable so you can set a default model for all new sessions without locking it in permanently — a /model command will still override it. Also adds a notify_when_idle option for cross-session SendMessage, useful for orchestrating multiple Claude Code sessions.

highlights.title: Claude Code v2.1.235 Released
highlights.summary: You can now enable a spellcheck setting in Claude Code that underlines misspelled words in your prompt input in real time, powered by aspell, hunspell, or ispell if installed on your system. This release also fixes two caching bugs related to language server disconnections and nested operations.

highlights.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5
highlights.summary: Anthropic has announced Claude Opus 5, the latest and most capable model in the Claude family. Developers using Claude Code can switch to it via the /model command to take advantage of improved reasoning and coding capabilities.

highlights.title: Maximizing the Value of Your Claude Code Sessions
highlights.summary: This Anthropic blog post shares practical strategies for getting more out of each Claude Code session, including how to structure prompts and manage context effectively. It's a great read for developers who want to move beyond basic usage and build more productive workflows.

highlights.title: The Ultimate Claude Code Tutorial (Beginner to Pro)
highlights.summary: A comprehensive YouTube tutorial that walks you through Claude Code from the very basics all the way to advanced usage patterns. It's a solid single-video resource if you want a structured learning path without jumping between multiple guides.

highlights.title: Anthropic Just Launched /design for Claude Code (It's Awesome)
highlights.summary: This YouTube video covers the newly launched /design command in Claude Code, which helps developers with UI and design-related tasks directly within their workflow. If you work on front-end or full-stack projects, this feature could save significant time when iterating on layouts and components.

highlights.title: AI Programming Tool Rankings: Who Is the Best AI Coding Tool? (Bilibili)
highlights.summary: This Chinese video ranks popular AI coding tools including Claude Code, opencode, Augment Code, Roo Code, and others across criteria like innovation, code search, context management, and ease of use. It offers a useful comparative perspective for developers evaluating which tool fits their workflow best.

tips_of_the_day: Switch to the new 'Concise' output style in /config when you need fast, results-first answers — it's especially useful during rapid iteration or debugging sessions where you don't need Claude to explain every step.

Set the ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL environment variable in your shell profile (e.g. ~/.zshrc) to automatically start every new Claude Code session on your preferred model, while still keeping the flexibility to switch with /model when needed.

Before starting a long Claude Code session, jot down your end goal in one sentence and paste it as your first message — this gives Claude clear intent from the start and reduces mid-session drift, saving you tokens and time.
